15–30 min (plus the trips until the boat is diverted)

A ghost ship haunts the waters between Venore and Darashia. Travel by boat on that route until you are hijacked by the {wiki:Ghostship}, cross over to the southern boat, kill the undead in the hold and open the coffin to receive a {item:Plate Armor}. You leave through a magic portal that drops you at the Darashia port.
